# Name attribution validated against the Catalogue of Life

*Generated by `scripts/validateNamesWithCol.py` against COL dataset `3LR`. 1456 Wikipedia `collision` rejections re-examined.*

| verdict | count | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `unknown` | 1024 | COL has no usable answer — left alone, needs a human or the acceptedId link |
| `safe` | 352 | our name is a COL synonym, the target is accepted — same taxon, description may be applied |
| `distinct` | 80 | both names are accepted in COL — genuinely different taxa, correctly rejected |
